name: NBlood
description:
NBlood is an accurate source port of Blood (1997), the legendary horror first-person shooter developed by Monolith Productions. Based on the EDuke32 BUILD engine, it brings Blood natively to modern Linux desktops.

Features:
- Native execution on modern 64-bit systems with high-resolution widescreen support
- Modern mouse-look, uncapped framerates, and customizable keybindings
- Full support for original Blood campaigns, Cryptic Passage, and community maps
- Accurate weapon physics, voxel models, dynamic lighting, and gore mechanics
- High-fidelity audio playback supporting original CD audio and MIDI soundtracks
